question: What mantra form arises when the syllable sa is placed at the beginning of the Kāmarāja?
premises: The syllable sa is added at the beginning of the Kāmarāja.
The resulting form is called Lopā.
This form consists of sixteen syllables.
inference: Placing the syllable sa at the start of the Kāmarāja yields the sixteen-syllabled Lopā mantra.
plain_english: When the syllable sa is placed at the beginning of the Kāmarāja, the mantra becomes the sixteen-syllabled Lopā.
